findings.evidence: The forbidden-character regex excludes neither U+061C (ARABIC LETTER MARK, a bidi control) nor U+2060 (WORD JOINER, a zero-width character). Embedded values such as "a\u061cb" and "a\u2060b" therefore pass line(), despite the documented rejection of bidi and zero-width characters. Extend the filter
findings.title: Invisible-character filtering misses advertised cases
